title: Jesse's month of bad luck after the visit, including an armed gunman

tellings.quote: building we work at, and an armed gunman runs into the building.

plain: Michels says that after a visit tied to the story of a strange ranch, he had a month of bad luck in Los Angeles, including the day an armed gunman ran into the building where he works. He tells this himself, as something that happened to him. The suggestion is that the visit may have brought trouble home with it.
